summary_en: Mitsubishi Electric to make PCI Energy Solutions (US) a wholly owned subsidiary. Deal value and acquisition terms not disclosed in excerpt. Transaction aims to strengthen smart energy business.
title_en: Regarding the Wholly Owned Subsidiaryization of PCI Energy Solutions (US) – Strengthening of the Smart Energy Domain
translation_en_brief: Mitsubishi Electric Corporation announced its intention to acquire PCI Energy Solutions, a US-based company, to make it a wholly owned subsidiary. The disclosure does not provide the acquisition price, number of shares, or detailed transaction terms in the excerpt provided. The stated objective is to strengthen Mitsubishi Electric's presence and capabilities in the smart energy market segment. Full details of the transaction structure, timeline, and conditions are expected in the complete disclosure document.
